mcpBlockedUnauthorizedDetail: Agent '{requester}' cannot run '{action}' on {dut}: missing required DUT grant. Enable the grant in Connection mappings → MCP service if intended.
mcpBlockedUnauthorizedAction: Grant the required DUT permission in duthub UI (Connection mappings → MCP service) or use a credential with the needed grant.
mcpBlockedManualTakeoverDetail: Agent '{requester}' cannot run '{action}' on {dut}: manual takeover mode is active. Click 'Release manual control' when ready to resume Agents.
mcpBlockedManualTakeoverAction: Wait for the human operator to click 'Release manual control' in duthub.
mcpBlockedNeedsInspectionTitle: Human intervention: DUT needs safety check
mcpBlockedNeedsInspectionDetail: Agent '{requester}' cannot run '{action}' on {dut}: the outcome of the previous protected operation is unknown. Inspect the hardware and click 'Mark safe & recover' in duthub.
mcpBlockedNeedsInspectionAction: Wait for the human operator to inspect the hardware and click 'Mark safe & recover'.
mcpBlockedProtectedDetail: Agent '{requester}' cannot run '{action}' on {dut}: protected operation '{op}' is running.
mcpBlockedProtectedAction: Wait for the protected operation (such as firmware flashing) to finish, then retry.
mcpBlockedGuiHeldTitle: Human intervention: GUI holds DUT control
mcpBlockedGuiHeldDetail: Agent '{requester}' cannot run '{action}' on {dut}: desktop GUI currently holds control. Click 'Release control' to let Agents proceed.
mcpBlockedGuiHeldAction: Ask the human operator to click 'Release control' in duthub (or launch with --release-gui-lease for unattended mode).
mcpBlockedMultiAgentDetail: Agent '{requester}' waited {waited_ms}ms for '{action}' on {dut}, still held by '{holder}' (queue {queue_len}). Check for Agent conflict or take over/release control.
mcpBlockedMultiAgentAction: Wait for the current Agent to release its lease, increase waitMs, or wait for human intervention.
mcpBlockedGenericAction: Check dut_status and acquire/renew the control lease before retrying.
